messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High Request Error Rate on inference-cluster-us-east-1 (P1) — triggered at 2024-04-12T09:45:11Z. Paging: @Priya (primary on-call).
Priya: got it, waking up. looking at dashboards now.
Priya: error rate spiked to ~28% for gen-large at ~09:42. latencies also up 2x.
Marcus: are we seeing any obvious deploys? I see a kube rolling update around 09:40 in the control plane.
Priya: checking deploys... /kubectl get rs -n inference | grep gen-large
```
gen-large-v12   3/3     3         3         09:38
```
Priya: that RS came up 09:38, cpu usage jumped on nodes hosting gen-large.
Eli: logs show a lot of transient OOMs in the worker pods before they restart. attaching snippet:
```
[2024-04-12T09:40:12Z] OOMKilled: process 'infer-worker' pid=1024 mem=38.7Gi
[2024-04-12T09:40:13Z] Pod gen-large-abcde terminated, restartCount=1
```
Priya: mitigation in progress — scaling gen-large to 0 then 2 with safer resource limits, rolling back to v11 if unstable.
Sophie: I'm starting a canary rollback to v11 in us-east-1 to see if errors drop. tagging cs: @Nora for customer impact heads-up. :loud_sound: 
Nora: thanks. flagging high-risk customers with recent traffic spikes (Client A, Client B). I'll prepare a brief for support.
Priya: rollback initiated at 09:52. ops-bot: please record action.
ops-bot: Action logged: rollback-to-gen-large-v11 by Priya at 2024-04-12T09:52:34Z. Incident ticket INC-2024-042 created.
Marcus: after rollback error rate dropped to ~1.5% by 09:58. latency normalized.
Priya: confirming metrics stable at 10:05. moving to post-incident mode.
Eli: collecting heap dumps + core dumps from affected nodes for root cause. will attach to the ticket.
Priya: thanks. Audrey (perf) — can you add quant/compilation artifacts that might correlate? (cc @Marcus)
Marcus: will do, adding perf traces and kernel selection logs.
Sophie: quick note — rollback restored capacity, but we still had some dropped requests to enterprise clients. Nora, any customer-facing notes needed?
Nora: support bulletin drafted and queued for review. will send to Client A/B with apology and brief timeline.
Darren: scheduling postmortem session — propose 2024-04-13 15:00 UTC. owners: Priya (ops lead), Eli (runtime), Marcus (deploy), Sophie (product).
Priya: works for me.
Eli: ok.
Marcus: ok.
Sophie: ok.
Priya: action items logged to INC-2024-042: 1) gather heap/core dumps (Eli), 2) perf/kernel logs (Marcus), 3) add safe-guard resource limits to gen-large manifest (Priya), 4) customer comms review (Nora), 5) RCA writeup draft (Sophie).
ops-bot: Actions updated on INC-2024-042.
Sophie: I'll start the RCA draft after postmortem. Can I assign reviewers? prefer Marcus + Eli + Legal if impact note needed.
Darren: add Legal for compliance review — @Darren adding Legal to threads.
Priya: quick root cause hypothesis in case useful for the writeup: new allocator changes in v12 plus aggressive kernel selection led to higher memory pressure on multi-tenant nodes, intermittent OOMs -> pod restarts -> elevated error rate. need to validate with heap dumps and perf traces.
Eli: agreed, but also saw increased batch sizes in the runtime logs during the window which could have spiked memory use:
```
[09:41:02] batcher: submitted batch size=64 for gen-large (target 32)
[09:41:03] kv-cache: miss-rate up 11% -> more mem per request
```
Marcus: deploy pipeline didn't flag the runtime config change; we need a gating test for memory regressions. adding as remediation.
Sophie: scheduling: RCA draft due by 2024-04-14 23:59 UTC. reviewers: Marcus, Eli, Legal. sign-off expected by 2024-04-16.
Priya: I'll post the timeline in the ticket and link this thread.
Nora: once comms go out, let me know. will coordinate with Client Success for follow-up meetings.
Darren: thanks team. summary: incident mitigated via rollback, metrics recovered, data collection in progress, postmortem scheduled, RCA draft + reviewers assigned. Please update INC-2024-042 with any new evidence.
Priya: closing on-call handover for now. keeping the incident ticket open for RCA artifacts. :white_check_mark: 
incident-bot: Incident INC-2024-042 status changed to 'Mitigated' at 2024-04-12T10:12:03Z.
